name: taskhandoff
description: Save and transfer unfinished coding tasks across sessions, agents, and humans

interface.shortDescription: Resume unfinished tasks across coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Create verifiable task checkpoints, detect stale repository evidence, resume work in Claude, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, or Cursor, and export human-readable handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Save my current coding task so I can continue in a new session.
Hand this unfinished task to another coding agent.
Create a human-readable handoff for my teammate.
